dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel aeroelastic model tests of a super tall building with external guywire support

description: Wind Tunnel Aeroelastic Model Tests of a Super-Tall Building with External Guywire Support is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Luca Caracoglia, Northeastern University (northeastern.edu). The data set shared herein is related to the test results of a set aeroelastic experiments, carried out in the wind tunnel of SOH Wind Engineering LLC. in Williston, VT (USA). The dynamic wind response of an aeroelastic super-tall building model with external guy wire support (bracing) was examined. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (PDF, ZIP). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-zb18-ws58. Keywords: wind tunnel testing, aeroelastic model, acceleration data. Published 2025-02-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
